evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system Jira (ACME), Git source GitHub (acme), Default branch develop, CI watcher CircleCI, PR shape draft-first squash CODEOWNERS review, Remote yes. I just ran git push on feature/ACME-1234-facet-sort — watch CI and follow up on the PR.
evals.expected_output: The widgets-like path: resolve the PR read-only, derive ACME-1234 and the in-review move through the profile's Tracker rules, make one batched offer with the move as a separate question, then watch and re-gather after the watch exits.
assertions: Reads the workflow profile rows from context and sees a CI watcher, so the watch path applies
Runs gh pr view to resolve the PR before anything else
Derives ACME-1234 through the detection order in the profile's Tracker rules, preferring the PR body
Resolves the move to the in-review state per those rules rather than restating the transition mechanics
Makes exactly one offer that gates the whole chain, with the tracker move as a separately declinable question
Watches nothing and mutates nothing until the user picks Proceed
Re-gathers statusCheckRollup after the watch exits and re-watches when checks are still pending or newly appeared

evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system none, Git source GitHub (acme), Default branch main, CI watcher none, PR shape n/a, Remote yes. I just pushed to main — follow up.
evals.expected_output: With CI watcher none there is nothing to watch: it confirms the push landed in one line and stops, with no offer, no watch and no tracker move.
assertions: Confirms the push landed — branch, commits, and a PR link only if one exists
Stops there because the CI watcher row is none: no watch, no offer, no re-request
Makes no tracker call, because Ticket system is none
Does not invent a CI provider or poll gh pr checks anyway

evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system Jira (ACME), Default branch develop, CI watcher CircleCI, PR shape draft-first squash CODEOWNERS review, Remote yes. CI just went green on PR #451 — it's a draft with ACME-2201 linked and I already approved the follow-up. Advance it.
evals.expected_output: Marks the draft ready, reports the reviewers the forge auto-assigned without adding any by hand, moves ACME-2201 to the in-review state best-effort, then names the merge capability as the next step.
assertions: Marks the draft ready with gh pr ready
Reports the auto-assigned reviewers, both team .slug and user .login, without adding reviewers manually
Performs the move of ACME-2201 to the in-review state after the forge action, per the profile's Tracker rules and best-effort
Does not merge the PR
Ends by naming the merge capability as the next step, leaving the invocation to the user

evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system Jira (ACME), Default branch develop, CI watcher CircleCI, Remote yes. CI failed on my PR after the push. What now?
evals.expected_output: Reports the failing checks, summarizes the failing logs, gives a short root-cause read, then stops and asks whether to investigate — with no tracker move on red.
assertions: Reports which checks failed and summarizes the failing logs via gh run view --log-failed
Gives a short root-cause read
Stops and asks before doing anything — no auto-fix and no re-push
Performs no tracker move on red
Does not name the merge capability, since the PR is not green

evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system Jira (ACME), Default branch develop, CI watcher CircleCI, Remote yes. I ran a git push but this branch has no PR open. Follow up.
evals.expected_output: Runs the read-only resolve, finds no associated PR, and exits silently with no output.
assertions: Attempts to resolve the PR with a single gh pr view
Exits silently with no output when no PR exists
Makes no tracker call and no offer
Exits the same way on a merged or closed PR

evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system none, Git source GitHub (acme), Default branch main, CI watcher GitHub Actions, PR shape squash, Remote yes. Green CI on open PR #77, which already has reviews from @alice and @bob (bob's re-review is already pending). Follow up.
evals.expected_output: The watch path runs because a CI watcher is named, only @alice is re-requested, and no ticket question or move appears at all since Ticket system is none.
assertions: Runs the watch path because the CI watcher row names GitHub Actions, using gh pr checks as for any other CI
Re-requests @alice via gh pr edit --add-reviewer
Excludes @bob, whose re-review request is already pending, along with bots and the PR author
Asks no ticket question and performs no tracker move, because Ticket system is none
Does not mark ready — the PR is already open, not a draft
Ends by naming the merge capability as the next step
